summary: The SuppressedError constructor follows the spec's six steps in order. NewTarget falls back to the active function, OrdinaryCreateFromConstructor is called with the [[ErrorData]] slot (mapped to ObjectKind::Error), and ToString(message) runs only when message is not undefined. The "message", "error" and "suppressed" properties are created non-enumerable, with ? propagation on every fallible step. The only lint flag is an expect() on agent.active_function(). A built-in always runs with an active function, so this is an invariant assertion rather than a made-up value or swallowed error. No special-casing, no hardcoded results, and no changes outside the ticket's file.
